subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should MCP-app widgets be first-class renderable board widgets in this feature, and if so which authorized contract should expose their descriptor or view?
rationale: The current protocol cannot render persisted MCP-app widgets, while choosing a descriptor versus a ticketed view is a durable gateway and UI contract decision.

options.title: Add an authorized MCP-app view contract
options.body: Expose a ticketed or otherwise authorized descriptor/view that lets the existing board UI render MCP-app widgets.

options.title: Defer MCP-app support
options.body: Remove MCP-app from this feature’s public board contract and accept only HTML widgets until the render contract is designed separately.

recommendation.title: Add an authorized MCP-app view contract
recommendation.body: Expose a ticketed or otherwise authorized descriptor/view that lets the existing board UI render MCP-app widgets.

likelyOwner.reason: The same merged board UI foundation and this branch define the cross-surface board contract.
